title: "Fish"
engine: markdown
extensions:
  term:
    shell: fish
    shell-args:
      - "--no-config"
      - "-C"
      - "`function fish_prompt; echo -n '$ '; end`"
    prompt: "$"
    init: false
    spacing: false
---

Fish doesn't use `PS1` — it uses a `fish_prompt` function. Use fish's `-C` flag to define a simple prompt:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: fish
    shell-args:
      - "--no-config"
      - "-C"
      - "`function fish_prompt; echo -n '$ '; end`"
    prompt: "$"
```

Note: wrap the `-C` argument in backticks to prevent pandoc from mangling the quoted characters.

## Basic Usage

```{term}
echo "Hello from fish $FISH_VERSION"
```

## Variables and String Operations

```{term}
set greeting "Hello, World!"
echo $greeting
echo (string upper $greeting)
echo (string replace "World" "Fish" $greeting)
```

## Lists

```{term}
set fruits apple banana cherry
echo "Count: "(count $fruits)
echo "First: $fruits[1]"
echo "Last: $fruits[-1]"
```

## Command Substitution

```{term}
echo "Today is "(date +%A)
echo "Files: "(count (ls))
```
